description: This file defines a React functional component called EditorPane for editing notes, including managing video attachments via URL or file upload, and editing note metadata such as title and content.

methods.name: SectionLabel
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a styled section label.

methods.name: onAttachUrl
methods.description: Attaches a video via URL to the current note.

methods.name: onAttachFile
methods.description: Attaches a video from a file upload to the current note.

methods.name: onTitleChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the note's title.

methods.name: onContentChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the note's content.

methods.name: onRemoveVideo
methods.description: Removes the attached video from the note.
